title: Local descent of continuous scalar cochain boundaries from the norm completion
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended norm topology. Let $\iota:\Omega\hookrightarrow\widehat\Omega$ be the isometric field embedding into its metric completion [lem-sfb-normed-field-completion]. Let $G$ be any profinite group (a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group), and let $S$ be any profinite set in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. For $F=\Omega,\widehat\Omega$ put $C_F^r(S,G)=C(S\times G^r,F)$, using all continuous maps [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], with trivial $G$-action on coefficients, $C_F^0(S,G)=C(S,F)$, $d^0=0$, and
$$(df)(s;g_1,\ldots,g_{r+1})=f(s;g_2,\ldots,g_{r+1})+\sum_{j=1}^{r}(-1)^j f(s;g_1,\ldots,g_jg_{j+1},\ldots,g_{r+1})+(-1)^{r+1}f(s;g_1,\ldots,g_r).$$
For every integer $n\geq1$, suppose $z\in C_\Omega^n(S,G)$ satisfies $dz=0$ and there exists $b\in C_{\widehat\Omega}^{n-1}(S,G)$ with $db=\iota\circ z$. Then there is a finite family of continuous maps $u_a:S_a\to S$ of profinite sets whose images jointly cover $S$, and there are $b_a\in C_\Omega^{n-1}(S_a,G)$ such that
$$d b_a=z\circ(u_a\times1_{G^n}).$$
For $S=\varnothing$ the empty covering family is allowed. Equalities are equalities of actual cochains, with no closure of coboundaries. This assertion assumes existence of a completed primitive; it asserts no vanishing of cohomology for $G$ and no comparison with internal right derived invariants.

proof.text: If $S=\varnothing$, take the empty cover. If $n=1$, $db=0$ and injectivity of $\iota$ gives $z=0$, with zero primitive. Otherwise $S\ne\varnothing$, $n\geq2$. Identify $\Omega\subset B=\widehat\Omega$ by [lem-sfb-normed-field-completion]. Its norm is ultrametric: two algebraic elements lie in a finite extension, so [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-absolute-value] applies; pass to limits for $B$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent scalar analytic expansion; assembly step 1. Original step 1.

proof.text: The clopen and open-normal bases follow from [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-clopen-basis] and [lem-sfb-profinite-group-open-normal-subgroup-basis]. Apply [lem-sfb-profinite-metric-function-quotients] to $(z(s,g_1,\ldots,g_n),b(s,g_1,\ldots,g_{n-1}))$ into $\Omega\times B$. Obtain surjections $p:S\to S_0$, $q:G\to G_0$, with $q$ a homomorphism and $S_0,G_0$ metrizable. The second component is independent of its last argument by surjectivity, so evaluation there at $1$ descends $b$. Surjectivity on powers gives $dz_0=0$, $db_0=\iota z_0$. Work on these quotients; a primitive pulls back by $p\times q^{n-1}$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent scalar analytic expansion; assembly step 2. Original step 2.

proof.text: Choose increasing closed finite fields $F_N$ covering $\Omega$ by [lem-sfb-algcl-countable-closed-finite-cover], with $E=\mathbf Q_\ell$. Apply [lem-sfb-cochain-closed-rectangle-certificates] to $z$: obtain nonempty closed $A_j$ covering $S$, rectangles $R_j$ and field indices $N_j$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent scalar analytic expansion; assembly step 3. Original steps 3–4.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-closed-cover-retractions-stabilizing-selectors] to this closed cover. Obtain continuous retractions $\rho_j:S\to A_j$ and locally constant $k_i:S\to\{1,\ldots,i\}$ eventually equal, at each $s$, to the least $j$ containing $s$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent scalar analytic expansion; assembly step 4. Original steps 5–6.

proof.text: For each $R_j$, choose $T_j$ from [lem-sfb-finite-index-rectangle-primitive-operator], with $C_j=|[G:H_j]|_\ell^{-1}\geq1$. Apply [lem-sfb-accelerated-finite-field-cochain-differences] to $z,b,F_N,N_j,C_j$. It gives $e_i,c_i$ with $dc_i=e_i$, the required norm bounds, uniform telescoping limit $z$, and pointwise eventual vanishing of $e_i$. For $a\in A_j$ and $j\leq i$, its last clause gives $f_{e_i}(a,R_j)=0$; the operator therefore gives $dT_je_i(a,-)=e_i(a,-)$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent scalar analytic expansion; assembly step 5. Original steps 7–10 and certificate check of step 11.

proof.text: All hypotheses of [lem-sfb-retracted-cochain-primitive-summation] now hold with $V=\Omega$. Its corrected cochains have a uniform limit $b_*$ in the completion, but pointwise finite values in $\Omega$, and it gives $db_*=z$ in the original norm topology. Pull back as in step 2 and use the single identity cover of the original $S$.
